fact_text: An EP holder issued a work pass valid for at least 1 year is treated as a Singapore tax resident.
evidence_quote: Foreigners issued with a work pass that is valid for at least 1 year will also be treated as a tax resident.

fact_text: A foreigner whose stay in Singapore is less than 183 days in the year is a non-resident for tax.
evidence_quote: If your stay in Singapore is less than 183 days, you will be regarded as a non-resident.

fact_text: Tax residents' income after allowable deductions is taxed at progressive rates from 0% to 24%.
evidence_quote: is subject to income tax at progressive rates ranging from 0% to 24%.

fact_text: The professional temporary residence visa authorises a foreign professional/technician to establish in Ecuador for professional activity.
evidence_quote: Autorización de residencia temporal que otorga el Estado ecuatoriano a las personas extranjeras que tienen la intención de establecerse en el país para realizar actividades de Profesional, técnico, tecnólogo o artesano.

fact_text: Requires the professional/technical qualification, apostilled or legalised, plus its registration before the competent Ecuadorian authority.
evidence_quote: Título profesional, título de técnico o tecnólogo, apostillado en caso de haber sido emitido en un país parte del Convenio de la Apostilla de La Haya; o, legalizado si ha sido emitido en un país que no sea parte de dicho convenio

fact_text: Requires a passport valid for at least six months.
evidence_quote: Pasaporte válido y con un periodo de vigencia mínimo de seis (6) meses

fact_text: Requires an original criminal-record certificate from the country of origin (or countries of residence in the last five years), translated, apostilled or legalised.
evidence_quote: Certificado original de antecedentes penales del país de origen o en los que hubiese residido durante los últimos cinco años, traducido, apostillado o legalizado.

fact_text: Fees: USD $50 to apply and USD $270 to grant the visa (no VAT).
evidence_quote: Solicitud de visa USD $50, Otorgamiento de visa USD $270. No grava IVA.

fact_text: The visa application is done only online, through the MREMH official platform e-VISAS.
evidence_quote: El trámite de solicitud de visa se realiza únicamente de manera virtual, a través de la plataforma oficial del Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores y Movilidad Humana denominada e-VISAS.

fact_text: Ecuador tourist status (the 90-day visitor permanence) is for tourism and prohibits all labour activity — a US professional cannot work on tourist entry and must obtain a residence visa first.
evidence_quote: con el ánimo de realizar actividades turísticas y están prohibidas de realizar actividades laborales
